observed.assembled_3.png: Raised, rotation W. Mirror of assembled_2, with the hinge and upright leaf at the east bank. The slack loops on both banks are the same as in assembled_2.
observed.assembled_4.png: Raised, rotation N. The raised leaf is shown as a tall plank panel with iron bands over the pit, hinged at the south edge. observed.assembled_5.png: Raised, rotation S. A plank leaf with X-bracing stands at the north hinge bank. Below the pit, two bollards have narrow arched slack ropes, which again read as standing hooks rather than loops on the ground.
observed.assembled_6.png: The three anchor sprite files at large size on ground colour. South: two bollards with ropes running down (toward the camera) from the base. CAMERA.seen: Every bollard is drawn upright with vertical sides, a lit elliptical top cap and an elliptical base flange, from an oblique camera and not as a top-down circle. The same post is used in every facing, as the description says.

BORE.seen: Solid ropes and posts; there is no pipe or hose with an open bore.

PORTS.seen: Lowered: each rope leaves its bollard base at ground level and ends at the deck end edge in S, N, E and W. Raised: each slack rope starts at its bollard base.

PORTS_DRAWN.seen: Each bollard has exactly one rope, running toward the deck it faces, in every facing and state. There are no extra connectors.

LAYERS.seen: North sprite: the post is drawn over the rope running away from the camera. South sprite: the rope comes out in front of the base. Lower-bank bollards in S/N scenes cover their incoming rope ends.

ROTATIONS.seen: The bollard and palette are the same in all three sprite files. Only the rope direction changes, as specified. The 133% height spread comes from the rope running horizontally (east) rather than vertically (S/N), not from a change in the post.

SIGNATURE.seen: There are two upright mooring bollards per anchor square, each with one rope to the deck. Lowered ropes are continuous to the deck; raised ropes are slack on the bank.

MATERIAL.seen: The staved wood post has grain on the cap, and the rust-orange riveted straps and bolted flange read as weathered scrap metal. The rope reads as twisted fibre.

FOOTPRINT.seen: Both bollards sit inside the anchor cell on the bank; the ropes cross to the deck edge as intended.

ALPHA.seen: Every image given is an offline scene render or composite on ground colour. The code measured 'real alpha present: False' for south/east/north, but those are scene renders, so I cannot judge the sprite files' own alpha from them. No halo or painted shadow is visible around the posts.

OURS.seen: It is a new codex bollard composited with the mod's own painted ropes. I don't recognise it as a vanilla or other-mod asset.

OWNER_NOTES.seen: The owner's note 'Redraw the anchors as upright bollards' is done: the old lying-down fixtures are replaced by upright posts. The owner reserved the final judgement ('I'll judge after').

LEGIBLE.seen: At about 96 px per cell in these renders a post is about 18 px wide, so at 32 px per cell it is about 6 px. That is still a dark post-plus-line mark that reads as a tie-off point, but its banding and cap will be lost. This is advisory.

observed.east.png: Horizontal bridge render. Two bollards stand on the left bank and two on the right. A horizontal cable runs from each base to the deck's side edge, at the heights of the deck's upper and lower lanes. The bollards are upright, with elliptical caps.
observed.north.png: Same layout as south. The bollards look identical. Cables run from the bollards to the deck ends, and on the top pair each cable passes behind its post.

observed.assembled_5.png: Raised, north rotation. The leaf lies over the pit as a riveted steel plate. The top bollards have slack cable loops hanging down toward the pit; the bottom bollards have loops curling up toward the pit.

CAMERA.seen: The bollard caps and base flanges are flattened ellipses with lit tops, and the bodies are vertical cylinders. They read as the ~35° building camera, not a top-down disc or a side elevation.

BORE.seen: No pipe or hose. The cables are solid lines with no open ends shown.

PORTS.seen: Lowered (E, W and the S/N facings): each cable runs from its bollard to the deck end edge at ground level, in the same plane. Raised: each cable ends in a loop on the bank beside its own bollard.

PORTS_DRAWN.seen: Each bollard has exactly one cable, heading toward the deck it faces, in every facing. There are no extra connectors.

LAYERS.seen: In the north facing the cable runs away from the camera and passes behind the post. In south and east the cable leaves from the base on the near or side face. The raised-south leaf covers the far bank as expected.

FOOTPRINT.seen: Both bollards and their cable runs sit inside the anchor cell between the bank and the pit edge. Nothing overflows.

ALPHA.seen: Every panel is a scene render or a sheet on ground colour, so real alpha cannot be seen (the code also reports no real alpha in these panels). No halo or painted cast shadow is visible around the bollards.

LEGIBLE.seen: A bollard is about 16 px wide in a ~96 px cell. At 32 px per cell that is about 5 px: two small orange dots with cables a sub-pixel wide.
